string.name: desc
string.value: While attacking with this skill, you have a chance to leave an assassin's mark on the enemy. The next attack on a marked enemy will cause throwing stars to form on that enemy and attack other enemies nearby.

string.name: h
string.value: Leave a mark on attack at #prop% chance. Attacking again will produce #bulletCount Throwing Stars to deal #damage% + #x% damage of player's level.
